name: Rune
description: Single source of truth for the Rune language. The tree-sitter grammar, the syntax highlighter, the studio's registry copy (studio/data/keywords.json), the codegen templates, and the lint rule set (spec + generated, consumed by rune) are all derived from this file. Hand-edit here (or via the studio) and regenerate with new/generate.mjs.

tags.label: Requirement
tags.description: Feature entry point / happy path. Format: noun.verb(InputDto): OutputDto
tags.summary: A requirement — one feature entry point, the happy-path end-to-end. Faults live on its steps, not here.
rules: Input must be a DTO (or inline {})
The last step must return the output DTO

tags.label: Module
tags.summary: Names the module this file describes; fills the <module>/ path slot. Optional (defaults to the filename).

tags.label: Entrypoint
tags.summary: An inbound entrypoint (HTTP route, CLI command, queue handler) — the inverse of a boundary. Its body references the [REQ] it dispatches to. [ENT:ws] instead declares a WebSocket socket: a `[ENT:ws] <surface> @ /path` header with indented `verb(In): Out` message topics.

tags.label: Polymorphic step
tags.description: Opens a polymorphic block. The noun names an interface; each [CSE] is a concrete case.
tags.summary: Opens a polymorphic block where the noun names an interface. Each [CSE] is a concrete implementation; they all share the interface's return type. The block ends when indentation returns to step level.

tags.label: Case
tags.description: A concrete case inside a [PLY] block. Followed by a camelCase case name.
tags.summary: A concrete case inside a [PLY] block (8-space indent, camelCase name), with its own sub-steps and faults.

tags.label: Constructor
tags.description: Constructor shorthand. Instantiates a class and adds it to scope. No parens, no return type.
tags.summary: Constructor shorthand — instantiates a class and adds it to scope. No parentheses, no return type; construction details are an implementation concern.

tags.label: Return
tags.description: Return a value already created earlier in the flow. The value must be in scope.
tags.summary: Returns a value created earlier in the flow — useful when the last operation is a side effect (like saving to a DB) but you need to return a DTO made earlier. The value must be in scope.

tags.label: Type definition
tags.description: Defines a named semantic type that resolves to a primitive. Format: name: primitive
tags.summary: A named semantic type built on a primitive (string, number, boolean, void, Uint8Array, Class). Gives meaning to a raw primitive — `id` vs `string`. Generics (Array<url>), tuples ([x, y]), and string enums ("a" | "b") are allowed.

tags.label: DTO definition
tags.description: Defines a reusable data contract. Name must end in Dto. Format: NameDto: prop1, prop2
tags.summary: A reusable data contract; the name must end in Dto. Properties reference types or other DTOs. `url(s)` becomes `urls: Array<url>`. A description is required on the next line.
rules: All defined DTOs must be used

tags.label: Noun declaration
tags.description: Declares a noun (subject) with a prose description on the following lines.
tags.summary: Declares a noun (a subject / class) with a prose description on the following lines. Its purity (pure vs data) is inferred from whether it's used at a boundary.
rules: Grammar form; the spec is moving toward [TYP] noun: Class

tags.label: Service declaration
tags.description: Declares a backing service: a transport (SDK/HTTP/WEBSOCKET/SIDECAR/NATIVE), a name referenced by service: boundary prefixes, its required env vars, and a required @docs link.
tags.summary: Declares a backing service (transport + name + env vars + prose + required @docs link). Boundary calls reference it as service:noun.verb(...).
rules: Transport is one of SDK/HTTP/WEBSOCKET/SIDECAR/NATIVE, written in parens: (SDK)name. NATIVE = an in-process runtime/std-lib boundary (filesystem, subprocess, crypto, clock).
Name must be referenced by a service: boundary prefix
Requires an indented `@docs <url>` line (the service's documentation link)

boundaries.description: 2-char colon prefixes marking a step that crosses a system boundary.

dtoSuffix.description: An identifier ending in Dto is a DTO reference.

fault.description: Fault lines: lowercase, hyphen-separated, indented under a step.

lint.message: line exceeds {max} characters
{tag} should be indented {expected} spaces (found {found})
DTO name "{name}" must end in {suffix}
[DTO] {name} needs a description on the next line
requirement input "{input}" must be a DTO or inline {}
requirement output "{output}" must be a DTO
{prefix}: boundary params/return must be DTO or primitive — got {bad}
{key} has an inconsistent signature ({got} vs {first})
[TYP] {name} is defined more than once
[DTO] {name} is defined more than once
[TYP] {name} is never used
[DTO] {name} is never used
[NON] {name} is defined more than once
[NON] {name} is never used
step "{step}" is missing a return type
last step must return {output} (the REQ output), got {got}
[TYP] {name} must be a primitive — it can't reference DTO {ref}
[TYP] has an unknown or invalid modifier
instance noun "{noun}" isn't in scope (use :: for static, or return it from an earlier step)
parameter "{param}" isn't in scope (return it from a prior step or take it from the input DTO)
"{ref}" is not a defined [TYP], [DTO], [NON], or primitive
generated DTO is missing runtime validation (class-validator / zod)
fault "{fault}" from {req} has no Deno.test in the generated tests
generated file uses a "../" relative import — use an @ alias
generated file imports npm:/jsr: directly — use a # alias
integration file doesn't reference its DTO {dto}
{from} layer may not import {to} layer ({spec})
re-exports are only allowed in mod-root / poly-mod / bootstrap files
import into a poly structure must go through poly-mod ({spec})
module {from} may not import module {to}'s internals ({spec}) — use core/ or its mod-root
data-layer method returns a raw object — return a validated instance (assert/plainToInstance)
coordinator casts to "{dto}" — validate the seam with assert({dto}, ...) instead of a blind cast
{count} sibling features export {name} with compatible signatures — extract a poly structure
feature extends poly base {base} — it likely belongs inside that poly structure
directory "{name}" is not allowed — name folders by role, not as generic buckets
loose grab-bag file "{name}" — put code in a named feature/role folder
module {module} has only {count} source files (< {min}) — consider consolidating
file sits in a rune-managed slot but no rune element declares it (orphan)
heal-rules entry still carries todo: true — enrich it (strict-gated: errors under rune lint --strict)

modifiers.label: Core
modifiers.description: Routes an element to the shared kernel (src/core/…) instead of the current module. Core elements are importable from any module; module elements are not. Allowed on [DTO] and [TYP]; not on [REQ].

modifiers.label: Open
modifiers.description: The OPENNESS MARKER: this endpoint is reachable WITHOUT a credential. Codegen emits it as `access: "open"` on the generated @Endpoint, which surfaces as `x-bedrock-auth` on the operation's OpenAPI — where the backend's policy table comes from. An unmarked [REQ] is authenticated (the backend slot's default), so openness is always STATED in the spec beside the endpoint, never inferred and never hand-applied to generated code. The only modifier [REQ] takes.

modifiers.label: External
modifiers.description: Marks a type whose value is produced OUTSIDE this module (another module's endpoint, a human). The declaration file is still generated; entrypoint codegen turns unproduced input fields of this type into $name external-input binds (ghost stubs mint them in dev). Composes with constraint modifiers: [TYP:ext,uuid].

modifiers.label: UUID
modifiers.description: Constrains a string [TYP] to UUID format (class-validator @IsUUID).

modifiers.label: Email
modifiers.description: Constrains a string [TYP] to email format (class-validator @IsEmail).

modifiers.label: URL
modifiers.description: Constrains a string [TYP] to URL format (class-validator @IsUrl).

modifiers.label: Non-empty
modifiers.description: Constrains a string [TYP] to be non-empty (class-validator @IsNotEmpty).

modifiers.label: JSON
modifiers.description: Marks a string [TYP] that carries a JSON-encoded object/array over the wire (no typed [DTO]); validates it PARSES at the boundary (class-validator @IsJSON) so invalid JSON 422s at the seam instead of degrading silently downstream.

modifiers.label: Integer
modifiers.description: Constrains a number [TYP] to integers (class-validator @IsInt, replacing @IsNumber).

modifiers.label: Minimum
modifiers.description: Constrains a number [TYP] to a minimum value (class-validator @Min(N)).

modifiers.label: Maximum
modifiers.description: Constrains a number [TYP] to a maximum value (class-validator @Max(N)).

modifiers.label: Positive
modifiers.description: Constrains a number [TYP] to be positive (class-validator @IsPositive).

modifiers.label: Example
modifiers.description: A real sample value for the field, emitted as @ApiProperty({ example }) — keep's runner and cake fill required, unbound input fields from it so headless walks don't 422. The value runs to the next comma/], so it cannot contain a comma. Composes: [TYP:ext,example=orders].

modifiers.label: From
modifiers.description: Field-source binding (OpenAPI's parameter model): where this field is populated from at the HTTP boundary — path | path* | query | header. Body is the default, so a field with no from= routes exactly as before. `path*` is the catch-all path remainder. The codegen appends a route segment for path fields and binds every sourced field into the DTO server-side (path/query in the URL, headers as request headers). Composes: [TYP:from=query,example=widgets].

bootstrap/.$desc: Composition root — wires modules, starts the app

mod.desc: app entry point and module wiring

modules.desc: module registry — generated by rune sync as runes are added/removed

stubs.desc: ghost-stub registry — generated by rune sync to mint placeholders for unfulfilled [TYP:ext] inputs; evaporates once every external input has a real producer

core/.$desc: Shared kernel — importable from any module

core.desc: shared-service rune spec — the single [SRV] declaration site for the whole project

mod.desc: pure logic, no I/O or side effects

test.desc: unit tests for the sibling mod

poly-mod.desc: barrel re-export for the active variant

mod.desc: optional dispatcher: selects + delegates to a variant for non-trivial dispatch (co-located _-prefixed helpers also allowed)
cross-cutting orchestration importable from any module (e.g. an auth guard) — may use core business + data

int.test.desc: integration test for the shared workflow

<module-name>/.$desc: Isolated module — imports only from core or itself

mod-root.desc: public API, only external import surface

<module-name>.desc: module-level rune spec — the source this module is generated from

sig.desc: spec-owned signatures, regenerated by rune sync

mod.desc: pure logic, no I/O or side effects

test.desc: unit tests for the sibling mod

poly-mod.desc: barrel re-export for the active variant

mod.desc: optional dispatcher: selects + delegates to a variant for non-trivial dispatch (co-located _-prefixed helpers also allowed)

sig.desc: spec-owned signatures, regenerated by rune sync

mod.desc: exposes functionality to the outside world

e2e.test.desc: cypress end-to-end tests for this entry point

<name>.desc: class validator and class transformer type definition

spec/.$desc: rune staging area — authored specs (runes/), data design + cake artifacts (misc/), UI prototype (ui/), founding product docs (product/), the ratified contract's machine faces (contract/)

<name>.desc: rune spec for a module (legacy flat layout — prefer spec/runes/)

runes/.$desc: Rune spec files — one per module (the canonical authoring home; core.rune holds shared [SRV]s)

misc/.$desc: data design (data.json, data.review.html) + keep cake artifacts (cake.json, heal-rules.json, scenarios/)

ui/.$desc: sprig UI prototype + design system (sprig:prototype / sprig:design output)

product/.$desc: founding product docs — spec.md + user-stories.md (rune:scope output)

contract/.$desc: the ratified cross-repo contract's machine faces — generated OpenAPI + typed client, the prototype-seeded draft, the breakdown binding (queries + commands; see sprig's contract.md)

specs/.$desc: Rune spec files — one per module

fixtures/.$desc: Legacy cake-artifact home (used when the project has no spec/ dir): cake.json, heal-rules.json

heal-rules.desc: keep cake self-heal rules — rune-generated starter, merge-owned

app/.$desc: sprig UI app (frontend) — its own layout (src/pages, shell, islands) is owned and validated by sprig, not rune; rune hosts it via serve.ts (Bedrock). Ignored here like spec/ui
